page.content:
Narrator, rival, and the man who waits — then shoots Hamilton.

How Aaron Burr connects

  • Work: Hamilton (musical) — Aaron Burr narrates Hamilton and fires the last shot.
  • Character: Leslie Odom Jr. — Leslie Odom Jr. originated Aaron Burr on Broadway.
  • Character: Alexander Hamilton — Burr's rivalry with Hamilton ends in the Weehawken duel.
  • Work: The Room Where It Happens — Burr sings The Room Where It Happens from outside the bargain.

What is Aaron Burr?

Aaron Burr is Hamilton's foil and the show's storyteller: the man who waits, loses the Cabinet and the presidency, and fires the shot at Weehawken that the opening number already promised.

Key threads lead to Hamilton (musical), Leslie Odom Jr., Alexander Hamilton and The Room Where It Happens.
